candidates.name: Cryoglobulinemia
support_spans: Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels (cryocrit, 16%)
multifocal intravascular fibrinoid material consisting of a mix of cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi
candidates.why: The presence of cryoprotein precipitate, elevated serum cryoglobulin levels, and intravascular fibrinoid material consisting of cryoglobulins supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Multiple Myeloma
support_spans: Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
candidates.why: The presence of an abnormal paraprotein band, monoclonal IgG-κ protein, and hypercellular marrow with plasma cell infiltration supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Amyloidosis
support_spans: Hypercalcemia (calcium level, 11.5 mg/dL)
Lytic bony lesions on CT scan of pelvis
candidates.why: The presence of hypercalcemia and lytic bony lesions may be associated with amyloidosis, particularly in the context of multiple myeloma.
